meta.source: Salesforce Data Cloud Platform Services Rate Sheet (Nov 2025)

items.label: Internal Data Pipeline
items.description: Rows moved between Data Cloud objects internally (no external ingestion cost).
items.usageNote: Charged when rows flow between Data Cloud DMOs/DLOs internally.

items.label: Batch Data Pipeline
items.description: Rows ingested from external systems via batch connectors (SFTP, S3, Snowflake, etc.).
items.usageNote: Applies to batch connectors and scheduled data pipelines pulling from external sources.

items.label: Streaming Data Pipeline
items.description: Rows ingested via real-time streaming connectors (Kafka, webhooks, event APIs).
items.usageNote: Higher rate than batch due to always-on ingestion infrastructure.

items.label: Batch Data Transforms
items.description: Rows transformed via scheduled batch data prep and Data Transforms.
items.usageNote: Applies to batch data prep recipes and SQL Data Transforms.

items.label: Streaming Data Transforms
items.description: Rows transformed in real-time via streaming Data Transforms.
items.usageNote: Higher rate reflects always-on streaming compute for transformations.

items.label: Unstructured Data Processed
items.description: Unstructured content (PDFs, text, images) chunked and vectorized for AI use cases.
items.usageNote: Applies to Search Index and unstructured data lakes for Einstein / Agentforce.

items.label: Data Federation Rows
items.description: Zero-copy rows federated from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, etc.
items.usageNote: No storage cost - data stays in source warehouse; charged per row read.

items.label: Data Share Rows Out
items.description: Rows shared out of Data Cloud to external consumers via Data Share.
items.usageNote: Applies to zero-copy sharing to Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks recipients.

items.label: Private Connect Data
items.description: Data moved over Private Connect (AWS PrivateLink) instead of the public internet.
items.usageNote: Applies to secure private network egress/ingress via Private Connect.

items.label: Profile Unification
items.description: Identity resolution runs that unify individual profiles across sources.
items.usageNote: Charged each time the identity resolution ruleset is executed on the source rows.

items.label: Match & Reconciliation Rules
items.description: Rows processed by additional match / reconciliation rule executions.
items.usageNote: Complementary to Profile Unification for advanced fuzzy-match scenarios.

items.label: Real-Time Events Processed
items.description: End-to-end real-time events flowing through Data Cloud (ingest to activation).
items.usageNote: Highest-value use case - covers full E2E real-time processing SLA.

items.label: Calculated Insights (Batch)
items.description: Rows processed by scheduled Calculated Insights (metric aggregations).
items.usageNote: Very low rate - designed for large batch aggregations.

items.label: Calculated Insights (Streaming)
items.description: Rows processed by real-time streaming Calculated Insights.
items.usageNote: Higher rate reflects real-time metric compute.

items.label: Predictive & Generative Inferences
items.description: Predictions or generative AI inferences (Einstein / Model Builder) executed on Data Cloud data.
items.usageNote: Applies to both classical ML predictions and generative model calls scored on DMOs.

items.label: Data Queries
items.description: Ad-hoc query API rows returned to Marketing Cloud, MC Personalization, Sales/Service, etc.
items.usageNote: Charged per row returned across Query API, SQL, and Personalization retrievals.

items.label: Streaming Actions
items.description: Real-time Data Actions triggered from Data Cloud (webhook, Flow, MuleSoft, Journey).
items.usageNote: Applies to Data Action Targets - one credit event per action fired.

items.label: Segment Rows Processed
items.description: Rows evaluated when a segment or attribute filter is published.
items.usageNote: Charged per segment publish job over the underlying population.

items.label: Batch Activation Rows
items.description: Rows activated to batch destinations (Marketing Cloud lists, Ads audiences, SFTP files).
items.usageNote: Very low rate - designed for high-volume batch audience delivery.

items.label: Streaming Activation Rows
items.description: Rows activated to real-time destinations (MC Personalization, Interaction Studio, live APIs).
items.usageNote: Higher rate reflects real-time activation infrastructure.

items.label: Code Extension
items.description: Custom code extensions running on Data Cloud infrastructure (DMO extensions, scheduled functions).
items.usageNote: Charged per compute unit consumed by custom code, DMO extensions, or scheduled functions. Introduced Nov 2025.
